doc: Golden vectors for the MMZS v1 scan-set block (docs/reference/mm9pdy-zones-format.md, Scan sets). Synthetic demo data only. skipped: per zone, null (every member scans) or the member indices (0 = the zone's lowest slot) left out of its scan set. frames: every 64-byte clone W frame in write order, the MMZ1 table's then the block's. block_hex: stream bytes 0 to 22 + L - 1. Rejects: the sector is the MMZ1 table of zones (encoded with no sets) with the 576-byte stream_hex in place; a reader finds no scan sets (reason is a word of the reference codec's reason) and still loads the table.

all_kind0.doc: Every zone scans every member (one given as an empty skip list): kind 0 throughout, L = 0, one block frame at 0xC040

two_kind1.doc: Zones 1 and 3 of 4 skip members: 10 + 16 = 26 member bits, L = 4, 6 pad bits

cross_c380.doc: 3,413 member bits, L = 427: the block is 449 bytes, its last byte the first at 0xC380

exactly_4432.doc: Exactly 4,432 member bits: L = 554, the stream is full (9 block frames)

over_capacity.doc: Zones 4 (999 bits) and 6 (100 bits) don't fit what is left and fall back to kind 0 (scan every member); zone 5 (400 bits), tried after zone 4, fits

stale_generation.doc: two_kind1's block left in place after the table was rewritten (one DELTA member moved, same member count)

bad_crc.doc: two_kind1 with the block CRC's low bit flipped

kind_3.doc: two_kind1 with zone 0's kind set to 3 (reserved), CRC recomputed

wrong_length.doc: two_kind1 with L = 5 and a 00 data byte appended (26 member bits need 4 bytes), CRC recomputed

pad_bits.doc: two_kind1 with bit 7 of the last data byte set, CRC recomputed

n_mismatch.doc: two_kind1 with the block's N = 5 (the table has 4), CRC recomputed
